extraFacts.fact: EN 13765 is the CEN standard for thermoplastic multilayer (non-vulcanised) hoses and hose assemblies for the transfer of hydrocarbons, solvents and chemicals; the printed marking EN 13765:2015 Type 3 states the edition and hose type.
extraFacts.source: EN 13765 (CEN), title and scope of the standard

faqs.q: What is the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar (A906PG) used for?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar (A906PG) is a multi-ply composite hose rated 20 bar working pressure, sold in 25 mm to 100 mm bore. Highly flexible hose for petrochemical plants and road tankers. See the [composite hoses](/c/composite-hoses) range.

faqs.q: How do I read the part number IH-IH-A906PG-025 of the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar?
faqs.a: The manufacturer part code of the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar is A906PG, and each size is listed as that code plus the bore in millimetres: IH-IH-A906PG-025 is the 25 mm size, IH-IH-A906PG-050 is the 50 mm size. IH-IH-A906PG-100 is the 100 mm size. Quote the full part number with the assembly length and end fittings.

faqs.q: What bore sizes does the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar come in?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar is listed in 7 bore sizes: 25, 32, 40, 50, 65, 75 and 100 mm. Specify the exact inner diameter, the assembly length and the end fittings when you request a quotation.

faqs.q: What bend radius and weight does the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar have?
faqs.a: For the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar, the minimum bend radius grows with the bore: 25 mm (75 mm bend radius, 0.8 kg/m); 50 mm (125 mm bend radius, 2 kg/m); 100 mm (250 mm bend radius, 4.8 kg/m). Allow for the weight per metre when you size supports and reels.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar (A906PG)?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar has a maximum working pressure of 20 bar and a minimum burst pressure of 80 bar, a safety factor of 4:1. The operating temperature is -30°C to +80°C. Refer to the datasheet for any de-rating at the extremes.

faqs.q: What is the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar made of?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar has a grey weatherproof UV, ozone and abrasion resistant cover over a multi-ply polypropylene/polyester composite wall with an internal and external wire helix. The lining is internal wire with polypropylene, polyethylene films and fabrics.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar follow?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar is printed with EN 13765:2015 Type 3, the standard for thermoplastic multilayer (non-vulcanised) hoses for transferring hydrocarbons, solvents and chemicals. The printed layline also carries the pressure and temperature. See [reading an industrial hose layline](/blog/reading-an-industrial-hose-layline).

faqs.q: Which fittings and couplings suit the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar takes the spiral-tail fittings in the [composite hose fittings](/c/composite-hose-fittings) range. Those include cam and groove halves with a spiral tail, hex male ends, flanges, and female liner with lug nut sets. Cam and groove halves are also listed under [cam and groove couplings](/c/cam-and-groove-couplings); match the fitting to the bore and follow the hose maker's assembly instructions.

faqs.q: Where is the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar typically used?
faqs.a: Highly flexible hose for petrochemical plants and road tankers. For selection guidance read [Composite hose explained: films, wires and the fittings that thread into them](/blog/composite-hose-explained).

faqs.q: How does the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar differ from the Oil Composite Hose 20 Bar?
faqs.a: The Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar differs from the [Oil Composite Hose 20 Bar](/p/oil-composite-hose-20-bar) in its listed specification. By the listing, cover Grey weatherproof UV, ozone and abrasion resistant against Black weatherproof UV, ozone and abrasion resistant PVC and galvanised carbon steel external wire; part code A906PG against A901GG.

faqs.q: Can the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar be supplied with a certificate or third-party witness test?
faqs.a: Yes, ask for it when you quote: the order form for the Chemical Composite Hose 20 Bar lets you state special requirements such as Lloyd's certification or third-party witness testing, and Indus engineering confirms the assembly drawing on the RFQ. We ship from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa and Asia.
